sources.title: Voluntary monitoring, reporting and verification (MRV) period for waste incineration
Voluntary MRV period for EfW and waste incineration

facts.source_fact: The voluntary MRV-only period started on 1 January 2026.
The Authority announced an intention for the voluntary MRV period to run from 2026 to 2028.

facts.expected_handling: Do not convert to mandatory duty.

facts.source_fact: There is no legal requirement to participate in the voluntary period.
There is no regulator fee for participation in the voluntary period.
There is no penalty for non-participation in the voluntary period.
Participation is nevertheless strongly encouraged by the guidance.
facts.expected_handling: Keep recommendation distinct from legal obligation.

facts.source_fact: The period is intended to help operators understand emissions and future cost exposure.
Reported data is intended to support more robust and granular emissions factors and policy development.
Future cost exposure and full inclusion details were to be confirmed separately.
facts.expected_handling: Do not infer future mandatory terms.
